text:
Type: perforated metal wall lamp
Use: reading light beside a bed or sofa, accent light on a wall; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, retro, contemporary
Materials: lacquered metal cone shade with small punched holes, round metal wall plate, plug-in cord with switch
Colors: warm ivory, light beige
Shape: tapered cone shade angled downward on a short arm from a round wall plate, pinhole dots in swirling patterns, cord hanging below, compact and light
Feel: soft, warm, cozy, gentle
Goes with: light wood, cream or white walls, soft pastels, linen bedding; Scandinavian or retro bedrooms

product.name: SNIG
product.description: Safety tested and tamper-proof to protect little fingers.
